text:
liam: FYI - customers reported apparent quota overbilling when using route-policy with "narrowcast". Their total tokens in Console mismatch billing by ~2x.

nora: repro I just ran: send 2 identical requests with header `X-Route-Policy: {"mode":"narrowcast","target":"hosted"}` and we get 4 token-ops in Console.

chen: quick check: our ingest pipeline tags requests by header name. We recently added `X-Route-Policy` but still keep legacy `X-Rwd-Routing` for compatibility. If both exist we might be counting both routes separately.

priya: which SDKs still emit the legacy header?

liam: looks like Go and Python still do by default. TS switched to opt-out mode last month.

nora: could also be Console aggregation: downstream joins might be duplicating per-route docs. Which side do we fix first?

chen: short-term: console should collapse attribution if both headers are identical in intent. Add a fold rule: if new header present, ignore legacy for attribution.

priya: long-term we should change SDKs. Plan: Python/Go add env var to disable legacy header (default ON for two weeks), then flip default off in next patch. TS to flip in next minor.

liam: rollout plan OK. need visibility: add metric `route.legacy_header_seen` and `route.dual_attribution_count`.

ops-bot: Alert created: CONSOLE-ROUTE-DUP-1760, assigned to @chen.

chen: I'll scope console change as very small: a single-stage map in attribution service. Will emit logs when fold occurs.

nora: add sampled request logs for 1% of traffic to verify headers during rollout. Also add a Console tile that shows legacy vs new header ratio.

priya: SDK test matrix: verify when route_policy present, only one routing header is sent if env var disables legacy header. Add integration test hitting staging ingest.

liam: docs/migration note: include code snippet for py/go to set ENV var or upgrade. Also call out how to temporary enable console de-dupe by feature flag.

chen: timeline: console de-dupe tomorrow morning, metrics + sampling this afternoon, py/go flags by EOD, flip defaults in 14 days.

liam: I'll draft a short post for #customers saying we're investigating and outline mitigation steps so they can opt out of legacy header emission.

priya: one more: ensure billing pipeline uses de-duped attribution before charging. I will coordinate with billing team.

liam: thanks. tagging follow-ups: @chen (console fold + logs), @nora (dashboard+sampling), @priya (sdk tests + helper snippets), @liam (customer comms).

(Decoration: avoid leaving console fold logic permanent. Set a 2-week automatic rollback unless metric `route.dual_attribution_count` reaches zero for 48h.)
